reasoning_content:
The test-project.qgz is in git (committed, 16 bytes). So it's part of the repo. The QGIS server returns 500 for it, because the placeholder is not a valid QGIS project. This is expected repo state - the repo ships only a placeholder and real projects are user-provided. The guide says MAP must point to a valid project. Since no valid project exists, we can't fully verify QGIS OGC rendering. But QGIS server itself is healthy (healthcheck returns capabilities 200 at `/`) and integrated auth works. The 500 is due to the invalid placeholder project, not installation failure.

Wait - healthcheck uses wget to `/` and got 200 with 615 bytes? Let me check the healthcheck def. The qgis-server healthcheck returned 200 with capabilities at root "/". Actually earlier logs: `GET /?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities HTTP/1.1" 200 615`. So QGIS server CAN serve capabilities without MAP at the root path (using default project?). But through nginx `/ows/` it returned 500 because no default project configured. Hmm.

Actually /ows/ maps to the fcgi with MAP required. The root / might serve default project. Let me check the qgis healthcheck and nginx.conf.

Let me check qgis/nginx.conf and the healthcheck.

This QGIS 500 is an edge. The summary already flagged it as incomplete/unknown due to user-provided project missing. I think the core application (backend, frontend, admin, db, tiles, webdav) is operational.

Let me verify the frontend actually talks to backend and loads data. Let me check the frontend's API_URL - it's `http://backend:8000/api/v1/` which is server-side SSR internal. But the browser would use PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.localhost/api/v1/. Let me verify the frontend page rendered with data (projects etc). Let me fetch a page that lists projects.

Actually the frontend is a SvelteKit app; SSR may fetch data. Let me check the root page output for actual content.

Let me also test a full user flow: create a project via API? That would modify data (allowed? normal runtime creation permitted). But maybe avoid.

Let me check the frontend HTML for evidence of successful SSR API calls. Let me grep for "Default" appeared? Earlier grep found "Error" 2, "error" 1. Let me look more carefully.

action.command:
cd /tmp
echo "=== qgis nginx.conf ==="; cat /workspace/deployment/qgis/nginx.conf
echo "=== fetch app page for content ==="; curl -skL --resolve app.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 https://app.localhost/ -o /tmp/app.html -w "HTTP:%{http_code}\n"; wc -c /tmp/app.html; grep -io "default\|Keine\|Projekt\|error" /tmp/app.html | sort | uniq -c
